name: Tungsten
author: emmanuel-g55932
description: A console-style home screen for Steam Big Picture: your games and the rest of Steam on a cross-shaped menu made for a TV and a controller, with an A to Z library, an in-game menu in the overlay, and your apps. Hold View (or press Ctrl + Shift + X) to switch back to Steam's own interface at any time. Beta, made with AI assistance (see the README).
